output.summary: Phase 1 reviews as in U16: per-task reviews and a whole-branch security review on the strongest model (With fixes; Important 4 and the result-summary gap fixed and re-reviewed). The real-check fix dc6d213 got an independent report-only review: Changes needed, Important 1 (counting ``` across the whole message rejected a fenced-only report whose JSON string quoted ```, which the old code read) and Minor quadratic regex on long blank runs (100K newlines 7.5 s); both fixed in 70d3d8a with RED first. Accepted and documented: the sentence before the block is discarded, and an earlier sentence-and-block draft voids the turn (pinned by test). Boundary unchanged: a report still comes only from the assistant's last text block, never tool output; a review report must carry the runtime candidate digest. Follow-ups found, not fixed here: runner/API error (turn.failed, exit 1) is classified as review fail and reruns build; a stopped lean task has no rerun; OAuth refresh lock left after the model-list probe (suspected).
